name: Parallel
description:
Connect your Parallel financial plan to Claude. Ask questions about your model in plain language and get grounded, real-time answers pulled straight from your live data, with no exporting, no copy-paste, and no stale spreadsheets.

The server exposes Parallel's core planning surface as a set of tools: query your P&L, revenue and expense forecasts, headcount and hiring plans, monthly reports, and the assumptions driving your model. Your assistant can pull the exact numbers it needs to answer a question, compare scenarios, or summarize where the business is headed.

Access is read-only and secured with OAuth. Your assistant can explore and report on your financials but never modify them. You connect once, scope what it can see, and revoke access any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Parallel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Parallel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.getparallel.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Parallel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parallel provides these MCP tools: ask_parallel, compare_scenarios, explain_metric, find_model_objects, get_metric_timeseries, get_model_changes, get_model_overview, and search_product_docs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Parallel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Parallel in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Parallel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Parallel is developed by Parallel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
